newsitem.title: EU: REPORT LONG-TERM DIARY FOR MARCH 3-DEC 31, 1997.
newsitem.headline: REPORT LONG-TERM DIARY FOR MARCH 3-DEC 31, 1997.

text.p: BRUSSELS - Justice and Home Affairs Council. No agenda yet available.
MONDAY, DECEMBER 8
BRUSSELS - General Affairs Council (To December 9). No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - Energy Council. No agenda yet available.
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 10
BRUSSELS - Transport Council (To December 11). No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - Economic and Social Committee (ECOSOC) holds plenary session (To December 11).
FRIDAY, DECEMBER 12
LUXEMBOURG - Luxembourg presidency hosts European Council of heads of state and government (To December 13).
MONDAY, DECEMBER 15
BRUSSELS - Farm Council (To December 16). No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - Environment Council (To December 16). No agenda yet available.
STRASBOURG - European Parliament holds plenary session (To December 19).
THURSDAY, DECEMBER 18
BRUSSELS - Fisheries Council (To December 19). No agenda yet available.
MONDAY, DECEMBER 22
BRUSSELS - (possibly) ECOFIN Council. No agenda yet available.
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 24
- EU institutions closed for Christmas holidays until Sunday, January 4 inclusive.
BIRMINGHAM, United Kingdom (NEW ITEM) - Group of Seven (G7) - Britain, U.S., Canada, France, Germany, Italy and Japan hold summit.
